title: Complete Waste of Money
text: I ordered the large dog box for our pit bull. The treats were an appropriate size for a chihuahua. The "meat chew" was gone in 30 seconds. The stuffed toys didn't interest her in the least, though she did rip one's leg off in short order the ONE time she played with it. I could have bought a second Kong and a deer antler for the same amount of money and at least had something that she'd like.
label: negative
